records.note: 八个仿真与真实任务，明确给出失效检测精度-延迟取舍与人力回报；但未交代传感器/执行器/算力。

records.title: Contact-UAN: Unsupervised Actuator Networks as a Residual World Model for Humanoid Control
records.note: 用 6.5 分钟真机行走数据训练残差模型，真机扭矩降 20%、力跟踪误差降 43%；未讨论失效边界。

records.title: Visual-Wi-Fi Navigation to Signal-Emitting Devices
records.note: 真机用商品路由器自建 Wi-Fi 传感器零样本部署，传感器与流程交代清楚；未提失效边界与实验次数。

records.title: YUBI-Real2Sim: 3DGS Scene Verification for Reliable Policy Evaluation
records.note: 两台双臂平台、200 度鱼眼加 3DGS/MuJoCo 流水线，九组中八组复现真实排序，并自认尚无通用准入规则。

records.title: PhoneBot: A Low-Cost Open Humanoid Robot Platform Reusing Smartphones
records.note: 真机走路与交互演示，复用手机作感知算力、13 个低成本舵机并给出实时通信框架；未提失败情形与规模。

records.title: RoboBugBench: Benchmarking Automated Repair of Real Robot Software Under an Audited Behavioral Oracle
records.note: 33 个真实 ROS 2 缺陷、以仿真行为评分，并自审门槛给出 counterfeit 全被接受的失败证据；真机与算力未交代。

records.title: Temporal Visuo-Tactile Learning for Dexterous Grasp Stability
records.note: 一万次抓取、200 个物体、四枚 Digit 360 触觉传感器，真机在线门控使成功率升 10.5 个百分点；未讨论失效边界。

records.title: Immiscible Diffusion Policy: Preserving Multimodal Robot Actions through Label-Free Noise Assignment
records.note: 五项仿真加两项真机人形操作任务，指出扩散策略模态坍塌失效；真机平台与算力未交代。

records.title: What the Elevation Map Cannot See: Semantic-Aware Locomotion and Execution-Aware Navigation for Humanoid Robot
records.note: 摘要明确建模高程图看不见的危险物与执行偏差累积两类失效；实物仅用 Unitree G1 验证运动策略。

records.title: Adaptive Risk-Certified Event-Triggered Replanning for Dynamic Navigation
records.note: 给出非平稳基准碰撞降 83.3% 与预测不确定致罕见失败等证据并做硬件实验；真机与传感器细节少。

records.title: Stereo-Planner: Learning Stereo-to-Trajectory Planning for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Quadrotor Navigation
records.note: 摘要明说在装 NVIDIA Orin NX 的小型四旋翼上实飞至 7 m/s、机载推理 24.27 ms；未提失败情形，模块切分无取舍讨论。

records.title: RoboJEPA: Scaling Robotic Latent World Models
records.note: 12 种本体真实数据、8B 模型，提出想象误差随算力二阶幂律并零样本上真机；未提失效边界。

records.title: GG-Nav: Goal-oriented Grounding Chain-of-Thought Elicits Reasoning in Navigation Foundation Models
records.note: 消融指出证据缺失与停止错误两类失效，Go2 零样本部署；但未给实验规模与硬件细节。

records.title: JoyInside-VLM-Agent: Product-Conditioned Multimodal Policy Learning for Embodied Agents
records.note: 仅两个四足真实案例演示，自认公开基准结果 mixed，传感器与算力平台均未交代。

records.title: RoboFQE: Rollout-Free Evaluation of Visual Robot Policies from Offline Trajectories
records.note: 仿真与真机操作任务上保持策略排序，但真机部分无细节，传感器与算力未交代。

records.title: CSIR: Contextually and Socially Informed Robots for Efficient Person Goal Navigation
records.note: 合成基准加真机硬件测试，摘要未给实验次数与时长，传感器与算力也未交代。

records.title: When Routing Reveals Membership: Privacy Leakage from MoE Router Telemetry
records.note: 黑盒路由遥测+影子模型，机制溯源到隐表示投影，TPR@1%FPR提升2.7至9.4pp，并给出扰动遥测的保真度代价。

records.title: Power Side-Channel Membership Inference Attack on Embedded Machine Learning
records.note: 明示无需预测概率甚至标签即可从功耗迹推断成员，假设宽容，ROC-AUC达0.907并与影子/仅标签MIA在16组配置对比。

records.title: Physical Side-Channel Attacks on Edge LLMs: Extracting Output Tokens and User Prompts
records.note: 三种威胁假设对应被动EM测量与有限迹数，97.2%与94.3%及128k词表排名完整；仅在LLaMA-3.2-1B与树莓派5上验证。

records.title: Persona Guardrail: A Production-Grade Defense Framework for Agentic Systems
records.note: 明示黑盒威胁模型与语义白/黑名单的输入输出校验环节，给出准确率85.7%到95.9%、时延预算与误拦率等防御代价。

records.title: AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities
records.note: 明示全权重可见下仍不可诱导并依赖密码学假设，数字储物柜机制清楚；抗性结果仅定性，代价只谈审计失效。

records.title: Certified Mechanistic Edits: Behavioral Guarantees for Skill Removal and Preservation
records.note: 以黑盒测试无法证明移除为对抗设定，机制落于电路与权重编辑；保证范围、移除与保留权衡及9倍扰动维度明确。

records.title: ATTCK-R: Knowledge-Aware Long-Horizon Jailbreaking for Protected LLMs
records.note: 摘要写明面向受保护黑盒系统，明示ASR由0.896降至0.608并在9个LLM上评测；查询预算未交代，防御代价仅见旧防护被绕过。

records.title: Hidden Risks of Jev: An Empirical Study of Security, Privacy, and Dual Use
records.note: 威胁面清晰(注入、投毒、成员与属性推断)，官方API与可控训练数据区分黑/白盒；仅定性称仍易受攻击，无防御代价。

records.title: When Core-Network Elements Become Reachable: Field-Level Exploitability Analysis in Diameter
records.note: 点明S6a/Cx字段级可利用性与四类影响，召回94%到98%等指标齐全；威胁模型只称所考虑的，无防御代价。

records.title: RAISED: Self-Distillation for Robustness to Prompt Injection in LLM Agents
records.note: 明确工具返回内容为攻击面，自生成加自蒸馏的训练环节清楚；指出既有训练防御的效用漂移并保持通用性能，ASR无数值。

records.title: Discovery or Memorization? A Faithful Benchmark for Real-World Business-Logic Vulnerability Discovery
records.note: 明示黑盒/灰盒双赛道与沙箱神谕，报出最佳23.11%成功率及21.25%到40.83%；无威胁模型与防御代价讨论。

records.title: Combining Post-Quantum Cryptography and Quantum Key Distribution: Taxonomy, Constructions, Proofs, Standards, Deployments and Open Problems
records.note: 按安全模型、假设与可容忍妥协统一比较，组合器构建环节清晰，提及部署经济性与可信实体代价；无量化指标。

records.title: Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning: Enhancing Agent Security against Prompt Injection Attacks from Failure Experience
records.note: 点明外部输入被注入以劫持任务目标，自反思微调环节具体，在Llama-3.1-8B与Qwen3-8B下降ASR且保任务性能。

records.title: Constitution-Guided Watermarking
records.note: 离线调参与部署监控机制、质量与鲁棒性权衡、0.1%FPR下+14pp检出均明确；威胁模型与访问假设摘要未交代。

records.title: SatBleed: Security of Commoditized Communication Modules in Satellites
records.note: 定制威胁分类并锁定COM入口与接管目标，机制落到固件、协议与架构；仅给受影响任务数，无访问假设与防御代价。

records.title: From Requirements to Attack Trees: Grounded LLM Agents for Design-Time Security Review
records.note: 误用用例、攻击树与验证回环机制具体，含信任边界与数据流假设；攻击者能力与量化指标摘要未给，无代价讨论。

records.title: JASPER: Special Session on Joint Reliability And Security Assessment of SPlit Computing for Edge Robustness
records.note: 定位分割点中间特征同时受故障与对抗攻击，MRAD 44.3%到61.2%、ASR达98.8%均在ResNet-50上给出；无攻击者模型与代价。

records.title: Understanding Verification Vulnerabilities in Cross-chain Bridges: An Empirical Study
records.note: 把验证逻辑(状态证明、签名、发送方)拆成11种CVV模式，Macro-F1 51.2%对比29.3%基线；无威胁模型与访问假设。

records.title: Systematically Optimized CNN-Transformer with Focal Loss for Imbalanced Intrusion Detection on NSL-KDD
records.note: XGBoost特征选择加焦点损失加CNN-Transformer机制与98.73%准确率、R2L/U2R F1明确；无攻击者模型与访问假设。

records.title: An Evaluation of the Semantic Understanding Capabilities of Large Language Models for Web Attack Payloads
records.note: 四层语义基准240条与12.5%到50%漏检归因指标明确；无威胁模型、无攻防环节、无访问假设，属评测类研究。

records.title: GLIO2: A GPU-Parallelized Tightly-Coupled LiDAR-Inertial-GNSS System for Robust and Real-Time Global Localization and Mapping
records.note: 以现有scan-to-map两失效模式（退化漂移不可恢复、协方差过置信）为据设计联合因子图；桥面退化实验与三公开基准给出量化结果。

records.title: Embedded Bare-Metal Radar-Inertial Odometry
records.note: 以视觉/激光在感知退化下昂贵脆弱为据选FMCW雷达并全流程跑单核MCU；飞行实验以动捕为基准给APE/RPE；无经典方法继承讨论。

records.title: Contractor Filters
records.note: 以contactor组合代替几何包络重物化的理念交代清楚；离群/模型失配/关联歧义/多模态明确讨论且粒子滤波退化；纯仿真、无尺度。

records.title: Towards Certifiable State Estimation under Observability Degeneracy
records.note: 明确退化下SDP松弛秩膨胀致直接求解失效，提出候选驱动对偶认证与可观Hessian自适应阈值；仅称用退化配准验证，无数据集与尺度。

records.title: RAGNAROK: Radar-Aided Gravity-Normalized Alignment for Robust Open Keyframe-based Radar-Visual-Kinematic-Inertial SLAM
records.note: 明说failure-aware fusion与degradation-aware图像增强应对恶劣环境，模块设计有来龙去脉；但无经典滤波继承讨论，评测未列数据集。

records.title: Reinforcement Learning from Real-Robot Interaction without High-Quality State Estimates
records.note: 点明球不可观时UKF状态错误，据此仅在观测到球时修正RSSM隐状态；真机30分钟100%成功率对比0%；无经典继承与尺度交代。

records.title: HyperLoop: Hyperspectral-Assisted Loop Closure Detection in 3D-SLAM for Planetary Exploration
records.note: 针对感知混叠致RGB描述子退化引入高光谱描述子；MMOTS自采数据给ATE量化并诚实报告增益归因；非滤波/优化继承，无尺度。

records.title: DR-IPC: Disturbance-Resilient Integrated Planning and Control for LiDAR-Based Quadrotor Navigation
records.note: 指出规划与控制分层的问题并据此统一为NMPC，风扰/吊挂/球击等失败场景明确评测（任务完成1/10到9/10）；未改经典滤波、无尺度。

records.title: GR-LIO: A Local Ground-Aware LiDAR-Inertial Odometry System Using Body-to-Ground Height
records.note: 指出地面几何约束未被充分利用，把B-G高度纳入滤波并给初始化与在线标定；退化仅提抑制垂漂，评测未列数据集名。

records.title: Structural Foundations of Nonlinear Systems with Unknown Inputs: The UID-Induced Normal Form and Minimal-Sensing Structure-from-Motion
records.note: 基于未知输入可观性理论给出UID诱导标准形，明确继承经典可观性路线；明说结构与运动只恢复到未知全局尺度；实验仅称真实数据。

records.title: Sensor-Aware Joint Data Fusion and State Estimation under Sparse Multi-rate Distribution Grid Sensing
records.note: 对照经典方法在失同步/稀疏传感下的局限提出图ODE与图Transformer，并明确考察可观性退化；属电网域、无尺度、评测无指标。

records.title: RingNav: Task-Shaped Circular Memory for Visual Heading
records.note: 任务塑形记忆的设计动机明确（状态多于任务所需），TartanAir挑战赛量化改进，真机在严重视觉退化下仍估航向；无经典继承与尺度。

records.title: FOCUS: Fine-Grained Open-Vocabulary Change Detection for Uncertainty-Aware Semi-Static Scenes
records.note: 明确就地替换歧义与3DGS渲染不完美，用概率似然替代直接变化分；Isaac Sim与TorWIC上F1由0.20到0.84；无经典继承与尺度。

records.title: Tiered-Resolution Volumetric Mapping for Real-Time Simultaneous Planning and Mapping on Natural Outdoor Environments
records.note: 以仅少量地图在路径附近为据设计双层分辨率与规划到建图反馈；粗图路径质量崩塌作对比；经典对立泛泛、无尺度。

records.title: A Belief-State World Model for Catheter Navigation under Sparse Fluoroscopy: A Planar Proof of Concept
records.note: 把稀疏X光导航建模为POMDP，明确讨论状态不可靠时的不确定度提示；设计理由偏薄、纯仿真（自述无临床数据）、无尺度交代。

records.title: Differentiable Systematic Resampling for Variational Sequential Monte Carlo
records.note: 明确指重采样离散阻断梯度，提出温度可控systematic resampling松弛并给收敛率证明，对立OT类可微重采样；无退化场景、尺度与量化指标。

records.title: A Hardware-Partitioned micro-ROS Mini-Vehicle for Operator-Supervised Neural Driving
records.note: 交代硬件分区设计理由（实时安全留在车上、学习部分放车外），看门狗吸收无线抖动；无经典继承、无尺度初始化，评测无数据集。

records.title: Foundation Models for Autonomous Space Robotics: Architectures, Physical Adaptation, and Validation
records.note: 综述按感知-执行与部署验证组织，明确讨论传感器退化与状态估计对反馈/恢复的影响；无系统设计细节、经典对立与尺度交代。

records.title: Towards Path-Creative Navigation: Robot Navigation through Embodied Interaction
records.note: 指出现有导航假设环境固定，据此提出具身交互恢复自由空间的无地图框架；仿真加两个实机任务验证，无退化场景分析、经典对立与尺度。

records.title: Block Disentanglement in CRL: Bridging Identifiability and Visual State Estimation
records.note: 摘要只讲弱化干预假设下的可辨识性与受控具身应用，属理论目标陈述；退化场景、经典滤波/优化、尺度、具体评测均无证据。
